content.caseIdentity: Kihoto Hollohan v. Zachillhu, 1992 Supp (2) SCC 651
content.holding: Paragraph 7 of the Tenth Schedule (barring judicial review without State ratification) was severed, saving the anti-defection provisions of the Tenth Schedule.

evidence.note: 5-Judge Constitution Bench judgment in Transfer Case (Civil) No. 40 of 1991; 1992 INSC 48; 1992 Supp (2) SCC 651; 1992 (1) SCR 686.
